trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

- **Diagnosis:** v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all regions — the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollout confirmed active in all three regions.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.
